Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of ABBV.
Our cloud segment grew 15% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 15% to 13% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
Our gross margin expanded by 187 basis points to 74.1%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 187 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $22.8 billion this quarter, representing 15% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
